title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
dek: Presets, accessories and extras can be the most expensive part of the decision.
status: Published as a working draft. No named editor (FLG-R12).

body.text: Multi-function appliances advertise many modes. The titles we read mention presets, accessories and modes: {{P-02}} lists '24 One-Touch Preset Options' and 'Six Cooking Accessories Included'; {{P-03}} lists a '4-in-1' function set; {{P-01}} lists 'Hi-Fry' and 'Auto Shutoff'.

items: Which two or three functions will you use most each week? Buy for those first.
Do you prefer presets or manual settings?
Which accessories are included, and which must be bought separately? Check the listing's 'what's in the box' text.
What warranty does the listing describe? If the page offers an optional protection plan, read its terms before you add it. We have not verified any plan's price or coverage.

body.text: Amazon listings we checked offered optional protection plans from Asurion, LLC at checkout. This site does not recommend those plans, and we did not verify their terms.
We did not test any function or accessory. The list above is a set of questions, not a ranking.
